guarantees.title: Guaranteed Final Price
guarantees.subtitle: No hidden costs
guarantees.body: The signed budget is the final project price. No additional charge can be applied without written approval and a contract amendment signed by both parties.
guarantees.legalNote: Reference: Clause 4.2 of the JC Milian standard contract

guarantees.title: 2-Year Workmanship Warranty
guarantees.subtitle: Certified labor
guarantees.body: All work performed by JC Milian is warranted for 24 months from the delivery date. Installation defects are corrected at no additional cost.
guarantees.legalNote: Coverage limited to execution defects, not natural wear from use

guarantees.title: Binding Schedule
guarantees.subtitle: With penalty clause
guarantees.body: Project start and delivery dates are contractually binding. Delays attributable to the contractor activate a daily compensation established in the contract.
guarantees.legalNote: Clause 7.1 — $150/day compensation for unjustified contractor delay
